newsitem.title: USA: Middle Bay to merge with NPC Energy.
newsitem.headline: Middle Bay to merge with NPC Energy.

text.p: Middle Bay Oil Co said Friday it had reached an agreement to merge with NPC Energy Corp.
Middle Bay said it would issue 562,000 common shares and $1.2 million in cash to NPC in exchange for its stock.

It said NPC, an exploration and production company, would bring 469,000 barrels of oil and 3.6 billion cubic feet of natural gas to Middle Bay's reserves. The proved reserve value was estimated at $4.5 million, it added.
Based in Mobile, Alabama, Middle Bay is an oil and gas exploration and production company.
